# 模式切换说明
## 输入对应数字切换：
## 1.原生模式（更节省显存，支持生成1024以上分辨率的图片)
## 2.ControlNte模式（控制能力更强，但显存消耗也更大。此模式下，建议分辨率最高不要超过1024，如果1024还是提示超显存，那就往低调，直到不暴显存为止。）


# Mode Switching Instructions
## Enter the corresponding number to switch:
## 1. Native Mode (more VRAM-saving, supports generating images with resolutions above 1024)
## 2. ControlNte Mode (Stronger control capabilities, but greater VRAM consumption as well. In this mode, it is recommended that the resolution not exceed 1024 at the highest,If setting to 1024 still results in exceeding VRAM, then lower it until it no longer exceeds VRAM.)
